sonnet.problem: The setup line says Solomon 'looks underneath a smile' and 'what the bottom's hiding.' That rules out the wrong answer on the very next True/False card (a laughing heart is always a happy heart), so the baker gets the answer from the setup.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The two-blank question asks for the exact verbs 'discern' and 'deceives.' The setup card says only that the prudent man and the fool are 'each one on his own way,' so the baker can't reason out either word and can only guess the wording.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
